title: P6: named/default argument binding against catalog signatures
intent: Decide for #118 how named arguments, defaults, and positional arguments bind against Wright-owned catalog signatures: fully reordered named WorkshopSettingToggle, CreateInWorldText with reordered named args and a skipped default (Color), BigMessage with only Header named (first parameter omitted), StartCamera all named, user-defined userCall with reordered named args and skipped defaults, IsButtonHeld single named arg, SetInvisible single named arg, CreateHudText named with a null ternary receiver, and positional controls (Wait with enum, SmallMessage, BigMessage).

provenance.origin: Wright QA semantic probe for issue #118

provenanceNote: QA-authored source. Every call shape is modeled on the reachable protect-ban graph's own calls (WorkshopSettingToggle, CreateInWorldText, BigMessage, StartCamera, IsButtonHeld, SetInvisible, CreateHudText, createSelectionBox-style user function with in/default params), with the argument ORDER deliberately permuted so the canonical emitted Workshop order reveals name-based binding.
